snippet.title: Knowtorious Explained — Turn Your Living Room Into a Game Show
snippet.description:
Five original game-show formats, 400+ categories, and one host — you. Here's the whole thing in two minutes.

▶ Play your first match free: https://knowtorious.net

Knowtorious turns your TV into a trivia gameshow. You put the board on the big screen, split the room into teams, and read the questions out loud. No buzzers, no second app to download, no one else has to sign up — only the host makes an account. The app runs the clock, keeps score and handles the drama; you just press go.

WHAT'S IN THE BOX
- 5 game shows — Classic, Heist, Vegas, Carnival and Hex, each with its own rules and its own way to ruin a friendship
- 500+ categories — from Game of Thrones to World Cup history to space & astronomy. Pick 6, crank it to 12, or hit Surprise Me
- Endless questions — new ones every match, so the same category never plays the same way twice
- Lifelines & dirty tricks — phone a friend, skip, double points, sabotage, hexes, wagers… the toolkit changes with the show
- Built for the big screen — laptop to TV, cast it, or just turn the screen around

WHAT IT COSTS
Your first match is free. After that it's one ticket per full game night — about the price of a coffee. No subscription, nothing paywalled, and rematches of a show you already played are free.

CHAPTERS
0:00 Five shows, one night
0:12 Split the room into teams
0:19 Build your board — 400+ categories
0:28 The board goes up
0:35 Question up, 30 seconds on the clock
0:41 You make the call, the app keeps the receipts
0:50 Lifelines, sabotage and dirty tricks
0:59 Somebody's gloating for weeks
1:03 Free first show, then one ticket a night
1:18 CLASSIC — no tricks, just trivia
1:26 HEIST — every point is at risk
1:34 VEGAS — wager, spin, repeat
1:43 CARNIVAL — every tile hides a secret
1:51 HEX — claim, surround, conquer
2:01 Your living room just became a game show

PERFECT FOR
Game night, house parties, family gatherings, office socials, pub quizzes, road-trip nights in, holidays with the in-laws, and anyone who has ever said "we should do a quiz."

START HERE
🎟 Play free → https://knowtorious.net
❓ Questions → support@knowtorious.net
